title: H3 Context compact public manifest
description: The declared public surface only. Bindings, reachability, object-info and the fixture node inventory are absent by design: each is a pure function of these members, and `project_public_manifest_v1` recomputes them to produce the byte-identical v1 aggregate. A v1 document is not a v2 document -- the schema constants and $ids differ, and each reader refuses the other's schema value before reading any field.

contracts.description: The one canonical identity record for a public node. Everything derived comes from here.

capabilities.description: Reviewed maturity, milestone and evidence level. Not derivable from the contracts, so it is declared.

runtime_nodes.description: The two object-info fields the registered class decides rather than the contract. Ordered to match the contract registry.

workflow_fixtures.description: Fixture identity without a node list. A fixture's node inventory is a property of the file, extracted from it at verification time rather than restated here.

host_core_node_types.description: Node types a packaged fixture may contain that this repository does not own. Closed: a fixture node type in neither this set nor the contract registry is unknown, and unknown fails.

fingerprint.description: Release-integrity domain, matching the accepted M18-02 assignment for the v1 aggregate. It is not a semantic identity and no runtime consumes it as one.
